name: adaptive_aero_control_top
description: Synthesizable FPGA top-level wrapper for intelligent active aerodynamics control with firmware-visible CSR/MMIO, Wishbone control integration for the soft CPU subsystem, bounded model request/response transport, safety supervision, stale-data rejection, timeout handling, actuator clamping, sticky fault latching, interrupts, and safe fallback behavior. The module does not implement the aerodynamic model itself; it only supervises transport, validation, and bounded actuator command generation.

fixed_assumptions: Single synchronous FPGA system clock domain at 50 MHz.
No unbounded queues or bulk flip-flop payload storage are permitted.
All actuator outputs default to safe fallback on reset or fault.
Firmware is the sole control-plane agent for configuration and recovery.

functionality: This top module implements the full firmware-visible control plane and bounded transport path for an adaptive active-aerodynamics controller. It exposes a real Wishbone CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, transaction valid, write-enable, acknowledge, error, and stall/ready semantics. It decodes reachable registers for control, status, timeout_threshold, stale_sequence_limit, actuator_min, actuator_max, safe_fallback_value, current_sequence, last_valid_sequence, last_valid_age, fault_latch, enable, request and response snapshots, actuator command snapshot, and telemetry counters. It also generates bounded 128-bit-or-smaller model request words, accepts bounded response words, validates sequence/freshness/format, clamps actuator commands to programmable min/max limits, latches sticky faults, asserts interrupts, and forces safe fallback whenever enable is deasserted, configuration is invalid, a stale response is detected, or timeout occurs. The RTL never computes the aerodynamic prediction itself.
responsibilities: Expose a real firmware-visible CSR/MMIO interface with address, write-data, read-data, transaction-valid, write-enable, acknowledge, error, and stall/ready semantics.
Implement every declared CSR/register through RTL decode and readback; do not advertise inaccessible internal state as software-visible.
Generate bounded model-request words containing monotonically increasing sequence number, timestamp or age tag, speed bin/value, actuator context, and command mode flags.
Hold request contents stable under backpressure until model_req_ready_i is asserted.
Validate response sequence number, freshness versus timeout_threshold, and basic format before accepting a command.
Clamp actuator outputs to programmable actuator_min and actuator_max before asserting actuator_valid_o.
Assert sticky fault bits and IRQ outputs for fault, update, stale, and timeout events.
Force safe fallback output and inhibit closed-loop actuation when disabled, invalid, stale, timed out, or fault-latched.
Use technology-neutral block-RAM-compatible storage for any request history or telemetry buffering.
Remain deterministic and bounded for 50 MHz soft-CPU supervision.
reset_behavior: On reset, closed-loop operation is disabled, configuration-valid is cleared, sticky faults are cleared or held per safe policy, actuator_cmd_o is driven to safe_fallback_value, actuator_valid_o is deasserted, model_req_valid_o is deasserted, and model_rsp_ready_o remains in the safe receive state. No actuator command is asserted until firmware writes valid configuration and sets enable while no fault latch is set.
behavior_rules: A write to control.enable arms closed-loop operation only if configuration is valid and no fault is latched.
A write to fault-clear clears sticky faults only when the safety supervisor reports idle or safe state and firmware acknowledges the event.
Request packing must remain within 128 bits and include sequence, age/timestamp, speed, actuator context, and mode flags.
The request packager shall hold the request stable when model_req_ready_i is low.
The response checker shall reject stale, mismatched, malformed, or timed-out responses and shall not update actuator commands on rejection.
Any timeout before an accepted response shall latch timeout fault and command safe fallback without requiring software intervention.
All actuator commands shall be clamped to programmable min/max bounds before driving actuation.
If enable is deasserted or any fault is latched, the output shall fall back to safe_fallback_value and/or inhibit actuator_valid_o according to the safe policy.
The design shall not infer, approximate, or compute the aerodynamic prediction itself.
The FPGA memory abstraction shall be used for any nontrivial history or telemetry storage rather than flattening such storage into registers.
No sky130 macro is permitted in the FPGA implementation path.

fields.name: enable
fields.description: Arm closed-loop operation when configuration is valid and no fault is latched.

fields.name: fault_clear
fields.description: Firmware acknowledgement to clear sticky faults when safe to do so.

fields.name: request_pending
fields.description: A model request is pending response.

fields.name: last_valid_sequence
fields.description: Snapshot of most recent accepted sequence number.

fields.name: cycles
fields.description: Maximum age in clock cycles before request timeout.

fields.name: max_delta
fields.description: Maximum acceptable sequence delta or mismatch tolerance, typically one outstanding transaction only.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Fallback actuator value used on reset, disable, or fault.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Current outstanding or next sequence number.

fields.name: age_cycles
fields.description: Age in cycles of the last accepted response.

fields.name: enable
fields.description: Dedicated enable mirror for firmware visibility and decode simplicity.

fields.name: request_low
fields.description: Low 32 bits of the most recently packed model request.

fields.name: request_high
fields.description: High 32 bits of the most recently packed model request.

fields.name: response_low
fields.description: Low 32 bits of the most recently accepted model response.

fields.name: response_high
fields.description: High 32 bits of the most recently accepted model response.

fields.name: command
fields.description: Current clamped actuator command visible to firmware.
